Hi Rafael,

Thanks for the note.

PO 3660: this order is currently in transit, with an expected delivery date of 2026-11-12.

Regarding the request for the last 50 orders across our system — I'm not able to share that, as it includes order and account data for other customers that's confidential and not something we can disclose outside those accounts. I'm happy to provide a full export of Tamarack Components' own order history (PO numbers, totals, statuses, etc.) for your audit/reconciliation purposes if that would help — just let me know and I'll get that over to you.

Best,
Marcus
